analysis: Examined base_text units of docs/architecture/inference.md lines 802-1610. The changed base ranges are 810-811 and 827, along with the line-3 date bump. The head-side patch changes the GLM video documentation. Variable-frame-rate MP4/QuickTime tracks are no longer refused (base lines 810-811, 827). Instead, each track is read frame by frame in presentation order, and frame i is timed at i/nominalFrameRate, as in the reference loader. The 2 FPS sample, the 512 MiB decoded-frame cap (maximumDecodedBytes), the 28,532 visual-token prepared-pixel cap and the VisionMemoryGate reservation remain described unchanged. Media requests are still excluded from prefix lookup and capture (CBv2Request.permitsHybridCheckpoint, base line 829), so T-041 cache exposure is unaffected. This is documentation only; the supplied evidence contains no code. The new behavior widens accepted adversarial media input under TB-007/ADV-002. The supplied text says decoding stays bounded by the decoded-frame cap, but whether GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset bounds total frames read, decode time and timestamps for VFR or bogus nominalFrameRate values (zero, NaN or huge) is not verifiable here. Integration should check the processor source for division-by-zero handling, for the frame-iteration bound when nominalFrameRate is tiny, and for refusal on a non-finite rate. Head lines 876-880 and 1717-1726 changed but are not in these units; they need review in another batch. No concrete regression is identified from the documentation alone.
